name: Franchise Architect: Football
currentFocus: Session 93 ran a fresh /arc audit against live code and closed the last god-mode surface in the game. S63 had already fixed this exact shape one panel over -- its note still sits in GameSession.updateStaff: the Coaching Staff sheet was three free number boxes writing straight into the simulation. Eight lines below that fix, updateOwnerState did the identical thing to owner.facilities (training feeds the S90 development environment, rehab feeds injury probability, analytics feeds draft scouting), and public/game.html shipped it as three bare number inputs with no min, max or price. Every club is generated in [64, 82]; the panel's range was [40, 99]. Measured on a live decade (seed 20260307): the write cost 0M, club mean development tilt went 0.322 -> 2.847 against a clamp ceiling of 3.0, and league roster rank went 1st against the untouched control's 23rd -- so the S90/S91/S92 calibration guarantees were real but conditional on the player never using the interface the game ships. Facility level is now bought through investInFacility, priced by a pure superlinear cost function (no save migration needed), capped at three points per wing per league year and charged annual upkeep; updateOwnerState returns facilities-readonly. Two further defects in the same system shipped with it: gate revenue was strictly linear in a free ticket-price dial (4.61x revenue for a 4.59x price multiple, fan interest ending at 97 in every scenario) and now carries a league-centred demand curve under which the legal maximum returns 0.191x, worse than pricing at the league mean; and no club had ever changed a facility (training standard deviation exactly 5.66 at seasons 0/3/6/10 on two seeds), which an offseason AI investment round now moves. A ratchet defect inside this session's own fix -- priced construction plus a deficit-driven AI policy climbing +0.6/season toward a flat ceiling -- was caught by extending the measurement window and corrected with annual upkeep before shipping; dispersion now bottoms out and turns back up (5.658 -> 4.015 -> 3.655 -> 4.050 at seasons 0/3/8/15). 31 new node tests and 4 new Playwright specs. Public launch remains HOLD and launchReady stays false.
nextMilestone: No single blocking item is owed. The genius hit list is exhausted again; run a fresh /audit against live code next session. The highest-value known item is a gate for the long-horizon facility equilibrium: the season-15 dispersion turnaround that justifies the upkeep design is evidenced by a probe and asserted by no test, which is the exact 'argued rather than gated' shape this project keeps finding. Two lower-urgency follow-ups: owner.cash is now load-bearing (it gates facility construction and upkeep, and the previously unreachable cashPressure thresholds at 35M/80M are now reachable) and its scale has never been calibrated for a league where cash actually moves; and FACILITY_MARKET_PROFILE's appetite weights are judgement rather than measurement, making them the newest un-sourced constants in the codebase.

lastVerification: S93 canonical Node receipt 1,220/1,220 across all six shards, direct exit 0 (not a wrapper status), up from S92's 1,189/1,189 with 31 new tests in the core shard. Plus 4 new Playwright browser specs green, and the boot-budget, browser-reachability, API-contract-parity and public-truth gates all green. The owner Facilities panel no longer writes the simulation for free: measured on a live decade, the pre-fix free write cost 0M and took a club from 23rd to 1st in league roster strength; the priced path costs 357.8M and at least nine league years to reach the same ceiling. Gate pricing moved from a 4.61x free revenue multiple to a single-peaked curve where the legal maximum returns 0.191x. League facility standard deviation, previously exactly 5.66 forever on two seeds, now measures 5.658 -> 4.015 -> 3.655 -> 4.050 at seasons 0/3/8/15.
freeTierAuditNote: Session 75 refresh: browser-first game plus a bounded, cached community aggregate on the existing shared self-hosted server. No language model, email, paid analytics vendor, or per-user API spend; marginal cost remains zero within current fixed infrastructure capacity.

Run 1 was started before three closeout-time defects were found, completed core at 188/188, and was discarded rather than reported when a late doc-comment edit touched a file that shard had already read. Run 2 went the full distance and ended studio 206/207 on the browser promise-observability guard — this session's own bare .catch in tabSettings.js — which was root-fixed rather than accommodated, invalidating that receipt too. Behavioural source was frozen before this run. One JSDoc line in src/engine/facilityMarket.js was corrected during run 2 (a @returns shape that had drifted when upkeep was added), on the stated policy that behavioural edits invalidate a receipt and pure comment edits are disclosed in it.
